detail: The disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Regulations, 2011 has been filed by Satnam Arora with NSE. This regulation mandates disclosure when an acquirer crosses specified thresholds of shareholding or voting rights, or when there is an agreement to acquire shares that would trigger takeover norms. The filing is a mandatory step in the Indian M&A regulatory framework and precedes any formal open offer or delisting process. The specific shareholding threshold, acquisition structure, and timeline remain to be disclosed in the full Regulation 31(4) form.
